title: ApplicationReceived
description: The one shape every intake path (CRM webhook, email) produces. WF-10 accepts nothing else.

job_id.description: null when an email can't be routed to a job; WF-10 then sends it to NEEDS_REVIEW.

candidate.description: Personal data for the CRM only. Redacted before any LLM call and never used for scoring.

answers.description: Application-form answers. Questions differ per job, so keys are open; values are simple. null when the applicant sent an email instead of filling the form.

text.description: Extracted plain text. Empty string when extraction failed.

sha256.description: Hash of the normalized text, used in the idempotency key.

extraction_method.description: The method that was tried, even if it found nothing (a scanned PDF is pdf_text + NO_TEXT_LAYER). none = there was nothing to try: no attachment, or an unsupported type.

idempotency_key.description: Same delivery twice → same key → processed once. Format: <application_id>:<cv sha256 prefix>.

source_ref.description: Where it came from: the CRM event id or the email Message-ID.

duplicate_of.description: Business duplicate (audit item 4): the same person already applied to this job under a different application. Set at intake; read by the pre-filter's `duplicate` check. Redelivery of the SAME application is handled by idempotency_key, not this.
